title: Day 10 of AI/Algo Trading (Paper) - Posting for accountability
author: Enzobevmax
selftext:
**Day 10 in the books!**

**(Please see at bottom for answers to common quick questions - Added new stats)**

B.R.U.T.A.L. today(at first glance)

Odd split: Primary finished +4.5R but -$419 after costs (the losing burst carried bigger dollar risk).

**Changes before today:**

* 42 low-rep setups moved into **Explore 1** and **Live Lab** (21 each) from Testing 1 (12) and Testing 2 (30) (owner's call) - Primary unaffected 

**Today:** **Primary** \-$419.00 · Running total since Day 1 (10/23): **-$1,346.01**  
**Milestones:** M1 (3 green days in a row) 0/3 · M2 (8 of last 10 green) 4/10

**What went wrong today:**

* \-10.7R and -1.7R: Early Sellers (Strong Heat, Mid-High RSI), yesterday's two worst, red again.
* \-11.8R: 13 Strong Heat shorts in 10 minutes, all before the -2R stop could act. ***Basically, a backdoor loophole that we are now fixing.***

**How we're fixing it:**

* Tonight we dig into why both failed in two different markets.
* Testing paced entries and an open-loss stop, judged per setup; nothing live without my sign-off.

**What's helped before:**

* 16.8R+ saved on 11/2: I have a -2R per-setup condition-stop that blocked 30 bad entries(Clever, eh?)
* \+16.5R today: Gap-Down Pop Fade, Heavy Selling waited for pops, 12 of 13 shorts won. So could have been a lot worse.

**Quick update:**

* Testing 2's top-500 trial, day 2: -85.4R on 271 trades vs Testing 1 at +6.0R on 91 (-0.32R vs +0.07R a trade). **This is leading to our 3,000+ universe working better than a smaller pool.** Both handed low-rep setups to the new accounts today.

**Things I am also working on:**

* **"Hunch":** 200 learners operating independently that attempt to guess every next 3-minute bar, learn from each miss, and rank indicators. 10s of thousands of data ticks a day.
* **Market Compass:** Reads every 15 minutes where the market moved, whether it’s holding, and where it’s heading based on a rolling status. **We have many setups that excel in certain conditions.** Would be nice to attempt to switch those on/off based on early conditions. 
* \*\*\***FUN\*\*\* -** Instructed the system to pick as many or as few setups it would recommend for "best" primary account and to tally those metrics after tomorrow's close. Let's see what happens!

**Setup streak facts:**

Counted on traded sessions - a session a setup didn't trade is skipped. R after costs.

* Green: Gap-Down VWAP Loss Short (10% gap) (Live Lab) - 6 traded sessions in a row, +7.3R
* Green: Gap-Down Early Bounce Short (all day) - 4 traded sessions in a row, +31.9R
* Green: Gap-Down Bounce Short, Heavy Selling (all day) - 4 sessions in a row, +8.8R
* Green: Big Gainer SMA50 Cross Fade (all day) - 4 traded sessions in a row, +4.2R
* Red: Failed Prior-Day-Low Break Long (0.05 ATR, low volume) \[fill\] - 11 sessions in a row, -52.3R
* Red: Big Loser VWAP Reclaim Fade (all day) - 6 traded sessions in a row, -21.4R
* Rule changes in these windows: Failed PDL Break and Big Loser Reclaim Fade moved to the Graveyard (10/30, 11/2); VWAP Loss Short moved to Live Lab today.

**Quick answers to common questions:**

* Claude (Opus 5.5) - Python
* Alpaca API, paper trading, SIP market data (all US exchanges).
* US stocks + ETFs, intraday only (9:50 AM-3:55 PM ET), long and short, nothing held overnight.
* Setups built by basic indicators: RSI, VWAP, volume / buy-sell pressure, gaps, opening range, prior-day highs/lows, ATR.
* Setup Generator - A bot that invented 10 new setups a night (at least 5 long) and trades them on its own paper account. New concept: setups built randomly from random indicators. Paused after 10/28 so the existing ones get tested first.
* Setup Life Cycle - Idea or generator -> 2-yr backtest (costs in) -> test through replay sessions (20+ of them) -> Testing (paper) -> Primary (paper) -> real money after the milestones. Losers move down to the Graveyard, never deleted.
* Promoted / Demoted - Promoted = a setup moves up a level after earning it. Demoted = it moves down a level and keeps proving itself on paper there.
* Avg R - Average result per trade in units of the risk taken, after costs, fees and slippage (factored in already).
* Break-even win rate - Win rate a setup needs just to not lose money.
* Avg R w/o best day - Same, with its single best session removed - spots records carried by one big day.
* Accounts were meant to start at $100k; they could not be reset during earlier testing without conflicts, so some accounts started in a deficit
* **15,218 closed trades** across 23 sessions (10/6 to 11/5)(Not including replays and backtesting)
* **185 different setups** have traded live.
* **140,000+** setups/variations of setups proven unworthy for advancement. 

As always, thanks so much for the support and input!

Fun stuff!

replies.author: Enzobevmax
replies.body:
Yes. A major problem if I am short-heavy. You'll see above that we found a "glitch" that now needs its own rule so hopefully that issue will be mitigated moving forward. 

Had some big big wins for other setups though.

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Posting the bad bits, like the 13 shorts in 10 minutes before the stop could act, makes this much easier to trust. Two things I'd watch. Many of the top setups are gap-down shorts, so on a down day they can all win together and look like many edges when it's closer to one bet. And the Testing 1 versus Testing 2 comparison is only two days, so I wouldn't read much into it yet. I'd also count the 140,000 variations tried as trials when judging how lucky a promoted setup might be. Cymetica's Backtest Labs can hold the last 30% of history aside as out-of-sample, if you want another clean check.
